title: Fully delimited template expressions: must not be flagged
summary: Values such as `{{ vault_db_password }}` in YAML, JSON and other carriers. Covers 6 inputs.
rationale: A template expression is a reference to a secret, not the secret. Flagging it, or flagging only its inside, breaks templates that are correct.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, tutorial, reference, template or mask control whose expected silence follows a closed redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
